requirements: Country and indoor/outdoor rules permit 6 GHz operation
Required minimum Network and AP firmware versions for region
WiFi client supports 6 GHz and compatible authentication
wifi.notes: Outdoor AFC restrictions apply by region; WPA2-only SSID cannot use 6 GHz

requirements: AP uplink carries client VLAN tagged
Gateway has DHCP/DNS and required inter-VLAN policy
wifi.notes: Different SSIDs alone are not full Layer 3 isolation
Do not promise client roam times; verify the specific hardware and software
Channel AI recommendations are not a substitute for SNR/RSSI measurements

requirements: Tagged VLAN Management explicit for AP/Switch uplinks
switch.notes: Allow All / Block All / Custom affect Tagged VLANs; AP Native VLAN conflict can break connections

requirements: Per-port PoE mode supports each device
Total switch available PoE watts exceeds maximum load
Safe headroom and power supply considered
switch.notes: Max consumption not observed average draw; consult exact product spec

requirements: Edge and BPDU Guard evaluated by port
switch.notes: UniFi Gateway built-in switch ports do not support STP as ordinary UniFi switches do
May require manual port recovery after a loop
